partial_model.coordinate_frame: frozen initial measured seed-camera frame (not current live camera)

candidate_model.interpretation: two infinite fitted surfaces; finite assembly roles require caller evidence

quality.heldout_kind: entire independent profiles; before final all-data refinement
quality.reason: Measured/held-out radial fit or outlier fraction fails the geometry gate

branch_identity.basis: selected side of ordered seed laser profile
branch_identity.source: explicit caller selection; geometry alone retains ambiguous physical assembly roles

partial_model.meaning: Measured partial surface profiles support a rejected candidate pair of infinite known-radius cylinders. Candidate axes/wireframes are predicted fit geometry, not accepted tube reconstruction, weld profile, inward torch pose, or observed seam coverage.
partial_model.role_ambiguity: axis_role_ambiguous=true describes indistinguishable physical branch/main roles from equal-diameter geometry. The user explicitly selected left branch/coping_axis=0; this label is not an independent geometric identification or fit qualification.
partial_model.fit_failure: Nominal training robust RMS0.4205mm exceeds unchanged0.4mm fit gate; all-point RMS0.6478mm and several current whole-profile RMS values also exceed0.5mm. Nominal held-out robust RMS0.4407mm is below0.5mm, but does not override failed training/current-data gates.

coverage.angular_basis: actual measured seam radial angle around the fitted coping-cylinder axis
coverage.prediction_role: fit and planning guidance only; not observed geometry

photo_pairing_warning: Production scout native UV/XYZ profiles have exact source identities and measured camera poses, but no matched photos retained.
